meta.name: paper-search-usage
meta.description: This skill should be used when user asks to "search for papers", "find research papers", "search arXiv", "search PubMed", "find academic papers", "search IEEE", "search Scopus", or "look up scientific literature".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索并查找学术论文与科学文献
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速查找学术论文或科学文献
copy.tagline_en: Search and find academic papers and scientific literature
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly find academic papers or scientific literature

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以搜索多个学术平台的论文，包括 arXiv、PubMed、IEEE Xplore 等，并返回相关论文信息。
howto.when: 当你要求“搜索论文”、“查找学术论文”、“搜索 arXiv”或“搜索 PubMed”等时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜索 arXiv 上关于强化学习的论文。
say.note: Claude 会调用 arXiv 搜索工具并返回结果。

say.text: 在 PubMed 上找关于 CRISPR 的最新论文。
say.note: Claude 会搜索 PubMed 并展示相关文献。

say.text: 搜索 IEEE Xplore 上关于 5G 网络的论文。
say.note: Claude 会从 IEEE 数据库检索论文。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search for academic papers across multiple platforms including arXiv, PubMed, IEEE Xplore, etc., and return relevant paper information.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "search for papers", "find academic papers", "search arXiv", "search PubMed", etc.

say_en.text: Search arXiv for papers on reinforcement learning.
say_en.note: Claude will use the arXiv search tool and return results.

say_en.text: Find the latest papers on CRISPR on PubMed.
say_en.note: Claude will search PubMed and show relevant literature.

say_en.text: Search IEEE Xplore for papers on 5G networks.
say_en.note: Claude will retrieve papers from the IEEE database.
